human_reorganization: Section 6 reconstructs the actual infinite-dimensional Gaussian first-chaos source in L4 and exact Gaussian moments. It has weighted coercivity at every nonzero source, in contrast with the full Poisson L4 identity. The source embeddings, not just their probability laws, differ.

Under the Riesz identification the mapped normal map is N(h)=3||h||^2 h. Its explicit inverse, sharp global fixed-source constant 4/(9||h||^2), squared-chord factorization, opposite-half-source equality and inverse derivative are fully proved human deductions. They are not additional named Lean declarations. The local two-point estimate is proved separately by integrating the derivative on a ball away from zero. Exact sharp-constant priority remains unresolved; classical p-power context is credited.

Section 6.3 distinguishes the bounded infinite first-chaos synthesis from the physical scalar Gaussian L2 identity. Actual exponentials have L2 norm exp(theta^2), L4 norm exp(2theta^2), and belong to the original closed polynomial derivative graph by simultaneous Taylor value/derivative dominated convergence. Their L4-to-graph-norm ratio exp(theta^2)/(1+abs(theta)) is unbounded; no bounded extension agreeing on all exponentials or graph-norm L4 estimate follows. Every displayed exponential is individually L4-integrable. Normalized entropy equality and the graph ratio limit are labelled elementary human Gaussian-moment consequences, rather than additional named formal results. Classical Gaussian entropy estimates do not replace the quartic theorem bounded L4 operator hypothesis.

literature.review: Author-hosted primary Lindqvist notes, Section 10 opening vector identities and inequalities (printed pages 71–73) inspected. Classical radial p-power monotonicity context; not certification of priority for the exact fixed-source constant proved in the companion.
